Adding Reference Number in ILP

Implementations and SDKs
Mar 25, 2022
A
alfa
Mar 25, 2022 #1

Hi everyone,

In traditional money transfers, usually, we could add remarks, references, or additional descriptions for each transfer. Is that possible in ILP?

Many thanks,
Al

L
Alex Lakatos
Mar 25, 2022 #2

The Prepare and Fulfil packets have a data field, which is a Variable-Length Octet String. Connectors in the network DO NOT modify this data, and it gets encrypted as part of the packet, you can use those fields to pass any reference or descriptions you’d need.
